result.summary: Independently verified the ISS-0137 / GH #439 test-wiring fix. The fix is GENUINE, not cosmetic. Executed test blocks on `zig build test` rose from 701 (origin/main) to 865 (branch): +164 blocks across +10 new addTest targets, 776 pass / 89 skip / 0 fail. The +164 exceeds the design's 141 expectation in the correct direction (BACKEND-DEV landed 10 targets rather than 9, splitting src/oidc_jit_test_root.zig out after finding the named-module shim defect). No new target enrolls fewer than 4 blocks, so the '1 synthetic block instead of 16 real ones' failure mode is absent -- test-oidc-jit specifically reports the full 16. Three named-test spot-checks (tenant_context, claim_mapping, repository_canonicaliser) confirmed by-name execution via temporary forced failures, all restored byte-for-byte. C7 gate PROVEN to genuinely fire: de-wiring misc_unit_test_root.zig made `zig build test` exit 1 naming both orphaned files while all 763 test binaries were still green; exact restoration returned it to exit 0. ISS-0149 / GH #465 CONFIRMED pre-existing -- test-integration fails on origin/main with 15 distinct failing tests and 13 leaks, and every failing file exists on main and was touched by neither this run nor this branch. Zero new issues caused by this run.

issues.description: zig build migrate (and therefore test-env-verify check C3) exits 1 with 'BPM_DB_URL environment variable is not set' in a shell where only BPM_TEST_DB_URL is exported, even though .env defines BPM_DB_URL. Exits 0 once exported. Makes test-env-verify report UNHEALTHY for an environment reason rather than a real infrastructure defect, weakening the gate's signal.

tools/lint_test_isolation.baseline.json suppression drift: 128 suppressed on branch vs 131 on origin/main, surfacing 3 T020 MAJORs (cached_owner_tag, tag_repr_storage, tag_repr_lock in tests/integration/helpers.zig) that already exist on main. BLOCKER count identical (88) on both refs.

zig build test-integration fails on origin/main: 15 distinct failing tests, 13 leaked allocations. Already filed as ISS-0149 / GH #465 and enqueued on this run's issue_queue.json. Not a regression from GH #439.
